track.why: Logged route is PCT then the Silver Peak Trail; starts at the Windy Pass trailhead pin area, leaves the PCT at about 1.75 mi at the tarn exactly as our approach text says, summit 3 m from our pin; 5.8 mi round trip, June 23 is in season. Several other routes are stored on the peak but this logged name and report describe our standard line unmistakably.

facts.text: In late June, patches of old snow and ice can cover the PCT about three-quarters of a mile in, and the side-trail junction past them is easy to miss.
The turnoff from the PCT is a rock cairn pile with no sign; if you reach a small pond you have gone about 0.05 mile too far.
By late November the dirt road to the trailhead can be snow-packed and icy and suit only four-wheel-drive vehicles, so you may walk further than the summer distance.
Microspikes and an ice axe (late November, after fresh snow)
